role: Shared overnight-archive lookup helpers (availability, latest, byDate, inPeriod with the midpoint-in-day rule), the yyyy-MM-dd FactLocalDay formatter, a CMAltimeter availability helper, and the sleep.*, hrv.*, vitals.* and recovery.* assistant fact namespaces built from archived HRV sessions, with live HealthKit fallback for sleep.latest / vitals.latest / vitals.hr_now.
types: OvernightArchive: enum — shared overnight/nap/quick index lookups
toplevel: Global func CMAltimeterIsAvailable (CoreMotion is imported unconditionally). Namespace structs store `namespace` string constants and the injected SessionArchive (SleepNamespace also the settings closure).

units.does: Returns CMAltimeter.isRelativeAltitudeAvailable() for the app.capabilities altimeter fact.
Creates a new DateFormatter for yyyy-MM-dd pinned to en_US_POSIX, Gregorian calendar, device time zone (allocated on every call).
Availability for sleep/hrv/vitals/recovery (and some workout-detail facts): earliest...latest start date of overnight/nap/quick index entries, or .unavailable.

branches.effect: returns .unavailable so those namespaces vanish; else range availability

units.does: Picks the headline reading: among reliable HRV-bearing entries (optionally only scored ones), the newest midpoint local day, then the longest overnight on that day (else longest nap/quick), loaded lightweight from disk.

branches.effect: returns nil; else picks the representative of the latest day

units.does: Looks up the representative reliable HRV-bearing session whose midpoint falls on the given yyyy-MM-dd local day.

branches.effect: returns nil, which every caller reports as notRecorded 'no overnight session matched' instead of invalidParameter

units.does: Returns reliable HRV-bearing sessions (restricted to `types` when given) whose midpoint is in the period, newest first, each loaded lightweight from disk.
reads: file:archive session JSON (lightweight decode per session in period)

branches.effect: returns [] — every caller first rejects such a period with PeriodParser.invalidPeriod

units.does: Adds session_type to a .record value; non-record values pass through.

branches.effect: returns it unchanged; else adds session_type and returns the record

units.does: Filters index entries to HRV-bearing types that are reliable for aggregates and, when scoredOnly, have a recovery score.
Chooses the longest overnight among the entries, or the longest of all entries when there is no overnight.

branches.effect: pool = all entries (naps/quick); else overnights only

units.does: Entry duration = (endDate ?? date) − date, clamped at 0.

branches.effect: uses start date, giving duration 0 for an open/legacy entry

units.does: Entry midpoint = start + duration/2.

Builds the sleep record from SleepData: date, total/in-bed/awake minutes, optional efficiency/deep/rem/latency, merged sleep-science fields, and data_source=live_healthkit_pending_acceptance when live.

branches.effect: adds efficiency_percent; else omitted (wake not measured)
adds data_source live marker; else none

units.does: Runs SleepScienceAnalyzer on the night and returns fragmentation, awakenings, cycles, architecture score, front/back-loading, enhanced score, and age-norm range flags when a birthday is set.

branches.cond: analyzer returns nil (no night sleep minutes)

units.does: Sync sleep record from the session's frozen sleepSnapshot, labelled with session_type.

branches.effect: returns missing(notRecorded, 'session has no sleep snapshot') — no live fallback on this path (by_date, recent, session.* nested)

units.does: Snapshot-first sleep record; when the snapshot is nil, fetches the night live from HealthKit with a 5 s timeout and labels it.

branches.cond: live read returned nil (timeout, query error, or no sleep) — ?? fallback
branches.effect: returns missing(notRecorded, 'no sleep snapshot and HealthKit returned no sleep for that window'); else labelled live record

units.does: Fetches SleepData from HealthKit for session start..end (end defaults to now) and builds a live-marked record; nil on error or zero night sleep.

branches.effect: error swallowed, returns nil → caller reports notRecorded

units.does: Lists sleep.latest, sleep.by_date, sleep.recent.
Declares sleep.by_date($date): snapshot sleep record of OvernightArchive.byDate using the user's age and typical sleep hours.
units.entry: Invoked by FactResolverRegistry when the assistant's tool-use loop (or CompactToolRouter) resolves this fact key; availability closure is evaluated during tool-schema build.

units.does: Declares sleep.recent($period): list of snapshot sleep records for overnights and naps in the period; invalidParameter for an unknown period.
units.entry: Invoked by FactResolverRegistry when the assistant's tool-use loop (or CompactToolRouter) resolves this fact key; availability closure is evaluated during tool-schema build.

branches.effect: returns missing(notRecorded, 'no overnight sessions in period'); else list (items without a snapshot are per-item missing)

units.does: Declares fixed awaitable fact sleep.latest: sleepRecordAsync(OvernightArchive.latest) — snapshot first, live HealthKit fallback.
units.entry: Invoked by FactResolverRegistry when the assistant's tool-use loop (or CompactToolRouter) resolves this fact key; availability closure is evaluated during tool-schema build.

units.does: Builds the HRV record for a session: time-domain, nonlinear, frequency and ANS fields, minus the keys whose values the analysis holds as estimates (estimatedFactKeys), plus overnight_nadir_at_iso (only when nadirWallClock can place it, which needs the RR series — loaded through `archive` for single-night callers; list callers pass nil), labelled with session_type.
reads: file:archive session JSON (full decode with RR series, via nadirWallClock, when archive is passed)

branches.effect: returns missing(notYetComputed, 'session has no analysis result yet')

branches.cond: nadirWallClock returns a time (RR series available)

units.does: The fact keys whose values the analysis marks as estimated: sdnn_ms, pnn50_percent, sdsd_ms, sd_hr_bpm, window_min/max_hr_bpm (hrRange), sd1_ms, sd2_ms, sd1_sd2_ratio, each when its EstimatedMetric is marked.
Turns (key, Double?) pairs into a dictionary containing only the non-nil values as .double.

branches.effect: assigning nil removes/omits the key; non-nil stores .double

units.does: Time-domain fields: date, rmssd, sdnn, pnn50, sdsd, sd_hr, window mean/min/max HR, artifact_percent.
Nonlinear fields: sd1, sd2, ratio, plus optional triangular index, DFA α1/α2/R², entropies and whole-night nadir/min/max/mean HR.

Wall-clock time of the overnight HR nadir: RRSeries.wallClockTime(forTMs:) on the session's RR series, or on the series of a full retrieve from `archive` (the lightweight decode skips it). Nil when the analysis has no nadir offset or no series is available, instead of a startDate + cumulative-RR time that drifts by every strap gap.
reads: file:archive session JSON (full decode with RR series) when rrSeries is nil and archive is passed

branches.cond: no overnightNadirTimeMs, or no RR series on the session and none from archive (nil archive or failed retrieve)

branches.effect: loads the full session from archive for its series

units.does: Frequency-domain fields lf/hf/total power plus optional lf_hf_ratio and vlf; empty when no frequency domain.
ANS fields (stress, readiness, PNS/SNS, respiration, nocturnal dip, daytime resting HR, nocturnal median HR), only non-nil ones; empty when no ansMetrics.
Lists hrv.latest, hrv.by_date, hrv.recent.
Declares hrv.by_date($date): hrvRecord of OvernightArchive.byDate, passing the archive so the nadir time is placed from the RR series.
units.entry: Invoked by FactResolverRegistry when the assistant's tool-use loop (or CompactToolRouter) resolves this fact key; availability closure is evaluated during tool-schema build.
reads: file:archive session JSON (full decode for the nadir time)

units.does: Declares hrv.recent($period): list of HRV records (without overnight_nadir_at_iso) for reliable overnight/nap/quick sessions in the period; invalidParameter for an unknown period.
units.entry: Invoked by FactResolverRegistry when the assistant's tool-use loop (or CompactToolRouter) resolves this fact key; availability closure is evaluated during tool-schema build.

branches.effect: returns missing(notRecorded, 'no overnight sessions in period'); else list

units.does: Declares hrv.latest: hrvRecord of OvernightArchive.latest, passing the archive so the nadir time is placed from the RR series.
units.entry: Invoked by FactResolverRegistry when the assistant's tool-use loop (or CompactToolRouter) resolves this fact key; availability closure is evaluated during tool-schema build.
reads: file:archive session JSON (full decode for the nadir time)

units.does: Builds the vitals record: date, optional respiratory rate/baseline/deviation, SpO2 and min, wrist temperature deviation, resting HR, status string, and live data_source marker.
Sync vitals record from the session's vitalsSnapshot, labelled.

branches.effect: returns missing(notRecorded, 'session has no vitals recorded'); else record

units.does: Snapshot-first vitals record; when snapshot is nil/empty, fetches recovery vitals live from HealthKit relative to the session end (5 s timeout) and labels them.

branches.effect: closure returns nil; else live record

branches.cond: live is nil (timeout or empty) — ?? fallback
branches.effect: returns missing(notRecorded, 'no vitals snapshot and HealthKit returned no vitals for that window')

units.does: Lists vitals.latest, vitals.by_date, vitals.hr_now.
Declares vitals.by_date($date): snapshot vitals record of OvernightArchive.byDate (no live fallback).
units.entry: Invoked by FactResolverRegistry when the assistant's tool-use loop (or CompactToolRouter) resolves this fact key; availability closure is evaluated during tool-schema build.

units.does: Declares awaitable fixed fact vitals.latest: vitalsRecordAsync(OvernightArchive.latest).
units.entry: Invoked by FactResolverRegistry when the assistant's tool-use loop (or CompactToolRouter) resolves this fact key; availability closure is evaluated during tool-schema build.

units.does: Declares always-available async fact vitals.hr_now: newest HealthKit HR sample from the last 10 minutes with bpm, observed_at, age_seconds, source.
units.entry: Invoked by FactResolverRegistry when the assistant's tool-use loop (or CompactToolRouter) resolves this fact key; availability closure is evaluated during tool-schema build.

branches.cond: no sample (none in 10 min, timeout, or HealthKit error)
branches.effect: returns missing(notRecorded, 'no HR sample in the last 10 minutes …'); else record

units.does: Runs newestHeartRateInLastTenMinutes under a 5 s FactResolveTimeout.
Fetches detailed HR samples for now−600 s…now from HealthKit and returns the newest (bpm, date, source); nil when none or on error.

branches.effect: returns nil; else newest sample tuple
error swallowed (no log), returns nil → reported as 'no HR sample' even when HealthKit authorization or the query failed

units.does: Builds the recovery record: date, score on 0–100 (stored 0–10 ×10, clamped/rounded), scale, optional training_readiness and data_quality, subjective morning fields, labelled.

branches.effect: returns missing(notYetComputed, 'session has no recovery score yet')

units.does: Subjective morning fields: morning_feeling, morning_feeling_tags, perceived_readiness, notes — only those present/non-empty.

branches.effect: adds notes (free text the user typed)

units.does: Lists recovery.score.latest, score.by_date, score.recent, trend.
Declares recovery.score.by_date($date): scoreRecord of the scored representative session for that day.
units.entry: Invoked by FactResolverRegistry when the assistant's tool-use loop (or CompactToolRouter) resolves this fact key; availability closure is evaluated during tool-schema build.

units.does: Declares recovery.score.recent($period): score records for reliable HRV-bearing sessions in the period that have a recovery score; invalidParameter for an unknown period.
units.entry: Invoked by FactResolverRegistry when the assistant's tool-use loop (or CompactToolRouter) resolves this fact key; availability closure is evaluated during tool-schema build.

branches.effect: returns missing(notRecorded, 'no scored overnight sessions in period'); else list

units.does: Declares recovery.trend($period) resolved by resolveRecoveryTrend.
units.entry: Invoked by FactResolverRegistry when the assistant's tool-use loop (or CompactToolRouter) resolves this fact key; availability closure is evaluated during tool-schema build.

units.does: Rejects an unknown period (invalidParameter), windows reliable sessions by period, runs TrendAnalyzer.analyze(period: .all) (which keeps overnight-only reliable sessions with analysis) and returns the trend record.

branches.effect: returns missing(notYetComputed, 'need at least 2 overnight readings in this period'); else .record(trendRecord)

units.does: Recomputes the TrendVerdict on the summary's RMSSD data points (log scale) and returns recentChangePercent, or missing when unavailable.

branches.effect: returns missing(notYetComputed, 'need at least 4 overnight readings …'); else .double(percent)

units.does: Builds the trend record: overall, data_points, RMSSD trend/slope/recent-week change/mean, resting HR trend/slope, optional readiness trend/slope and insights.
Declares recovery.score.latest: scoreRecord of OvernightArchive.latest(scoredOnly: true).
units.entry: Invoked by FactResolverRegistry when the assistant's tool-use loop (or CompactToolRouter) resolves this fact key; availability closure is evaluated during tool-schema build.
